mentions.name: AI-powered ERP inventory integration tooling
mentions.description: This project explores building AI-based functionality to integrate with an existing ERP package used in a services-industry accounting context, aiming to work around its inventory-control limitations and make month-end figures worthwhile.
mentions.problem: The ERP package the author manages daily has limitations on inventory control, which is a pain point for accounting in a services industry.
mentions.source_excerpt: The ERP package that I manage and work on daily has some limitations on inventory control, possibly a signal to change packages, but other than the inventory issue, it serves 100% of my needs. Currently working with various AI platforms to see what functionality can be built to intergrate or at least make the month-end figures worthwhile.
